title: End-delimiter coverage via balanced TESTFR U-format control frame
purpose: Exercise a minimal but valid IEC 60870-5-104 control-frame parser path centered on a frame that terminates cleanly after APCI, giving a compact seed for delimiters and control-only handling.
expected_behavior: Peer should recognize a valid U-format TESTFR activation request and either answer with TESTFR confirmation or ignore per implementation policy; parser should consume the frame without entering ASDU parsing.
constraints_preserved: APCI start byte 0x68 used with length 0x04 for U-format frame and exactly 4 following control octets.
Frame is complete and self-contained; no truncated body or extra tail bytes are present.
U-format function selection is inferred from common IEC 60870-5-104 encoding because the supplied sources enumerate APCI/U-format categories but do not provide exact octet templates.
No historical crash payload bytes are reused.
issue_safety_notes: This seed intentionally stays in the control-only path, avoiding malformed lengths and avoiding the issue pattern of an object count exceeding available ASDU bytes.
